mountains.name: Mount Kibo
mountains.name_origin: “Spotted”, for its snow.
mountains.notes: Uhuru Peak (Q20727403) is recorded as part of Mount Kibo: Uhuru Peak is the highest point of Kibo's crater rim; the catalogue has two levels (massif and summit), so it is recorded as Kibo's summit point.

mountains.name: Mount Kilimanjaro
mountains.name_origin: Disputed. It may come from the Kichagga for “unclimbable” (kilemanjaare or kilemajyaro), which early explorers took to be the mountain's name.
mountains.review_notes: Name origin to verify: The source says the origin of the name is disputed.
